title: Easier Sea Lanterns
description: Changes the current crafting recipe to a more balanced recipe.
body:
# **Easier Sea Lanterns**

_This data pack provides a better, more balanced crafting recipe for sea lanterns. Simply place this data pack into the data pack folder in the world folder! 

This data pack may work on earlier versions of the game, but it has not been tested. HAPPY CRAFTING!_
